short: Optimizing Hydrogen Adsorption by d-d Orbital Modulation for
title: Optimizing Hydrogen Adsorption by d-d Orbital Modulation for Efficient Hydrogen Evolution Catalysis

lanes.label: Classical tools
lanes.sub: collapsed to one node per state

states.title: Hypothesis and design
states.head: Scalable alkaline water splitting needs efficient, non-noble HER catalysts rivalling Pt. Tuning W 5d-M 3d orbital coupling in WO2 with 3d heteroatoms should moderate H adsorption and raise HER activity.
states.detail: Absorbed: n1 (HYP/need), n2 (HYP/hypothesis), n3 (DES/base_system), n4 (DES/variable_sweep), n7 (DES/down_select), n8 (PRC/synthesis), n9 (PRC/synthesis). Premises: HER activity peaks where dG_H* is near zero (Sabatier principle)

states.title: Structure state
states.head: Rising M 3d filling weakens W-M coupling: bond order falls, W 5d-M 3d decouple, antibonding states fill. Ni-doped WO2 is single-phase monoclinic WO2 (no Ni or Ni-oxide phase).
states.detail: Absorbed: n5 (STR/chemistry/bonding), n10 (STR/phase/identity), n13 (STR/chemistry/composition), n14 (STR/chemistry/bonding). Premises: Higher d-band filling of a coordinating metal fills metal-metal antibonding orbitals and weakens the bond; Higher L3 white-line intensity and upshift mean more 5d holes, i.e. more oxidised W

states.title: Property state and mechanisms
states.head: Computed dG_H* on W-M sites is volcano-shaped, W-Ni (-0.43 eV) closest to zero. W 5d-Ni 3d decoupling lowers W-Ni bond charge and weakens H binding to a moderate level.
states.detail: Absorbed: n6 (PRP/descriptor), n15 (MEC/pathway), n20 (MEC/pathway), n16 (PRP/value). Premises: HER activity peaks where dG_H* is near zero (Sabatier principle)

states.title: Performance state
states.head: Ni-WO2/NF has the lowest overpotential at 10 mA/cm2 (~41 mV) among compared W-based catalysts. Ni-WO2/NF holds -100 mA/cm2 for 100 h with near-constant potential

states.title: Conclusion
states.head: d-d orbital modulation of WO2 by Ni gives moderate H adsorption and top alkaline HER among W oxides

nodes.title: evidence, F1
nodes.head: COHP: antibonding area just below EF grows from none (W-W) to largest (W-Cu). pDOS: W1/W2 5d overlap over the whole range in WO2; M 3d peaks sit apart from W 5d.
nodes.solves: Rising M 3d filling weakens W-M coupling: bond order falls, W 5d-M 3d decouple, antibonding states fill
nodes.op: compare across conditions, compare coplotted quantities, read trend, replot derived series
nodes.note: W-Fe and W-Co antibonding areas are similar and small; W-Ni and W-Cu clearly larger. Authors shade -1 to 0 eV and label 'Anti-bonding state' WO2 trace is labelled 'W1 3d' on the figure, text says W1 5d (figure label typo) axis inverted; Fe to Co nearly flat
nodes.detail: o1: COHP: antibonding area just below EF grows from none (W-W) to largest (W-Cu); o2: pDOS: W1/W2 5d overlap over the whole range in WO2; M 3d peaks sit apart from W 5d; o3: Mulliken bond order falls W-W ~0.61 > W-Fe ~0.35 ~ W-Co ~0.33 > W-Ni ~0.25 > W-Cu ~0.01
